note: What a server sends to break off an attack a unit is making. The header names the unit acting.

fields.name: missile
fields.note: The missile the attack would have thrown, where there is one.

bits.name: keepAnimating
bits.note: Set where the unit finishes what it was doing to look at.

bits.name: destroyMissile
bits.note: Set where the missile named above is to go too.

bits.name: unknown1
bits.note: Purpose undetermined; a server sends it set.

bits.name: summonerSpell
bits.note: Set where what is broken off came from a summoner slot.

bits.name: unknown2
bits.note: Purpose undetermined; a server sends it clear.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Purpose undetermined; a server sends these bits clear.
